1479-2841-6662-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6662-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

643-3899-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-3899-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1510-3899-4574-5849.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Melira
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

1492-2866-4986-6495.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-4986-6495.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1492-2866-4986-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4089-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4089-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Glasspool Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4089-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

261-338-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-338-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4478-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1322-2440-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1322-2440-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2116-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Spiteful Squad.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
2116-3967-6972.notes: When Spiteful Squad dies with a +1/+1 counter on it, that counter can be placed onto another creature. If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, it will be removed, allowing it to be returned via persist.

813-4872-7174.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1168-1479-2841-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1168-1479-2841-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2043-4715-4893-6753.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2558-4848-5226-5687.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2532-3464-4617-4906.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-3464-4617-4906.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos and Hyrax Tower Scout tokens trigger.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Hyrax Tower Scout trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

305-5149-5200.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
305-5149-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Tribe does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Llanowar Tribe
305-5149-5200.description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat.
305-5149-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

930-1591-3781-4050.description:
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-2557-2757-5702.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Dryad Arbor.
2366-2557-2757-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control at least one basic Forest, or the land card in your hand is a basic Forest.
2366-2557-2757-5702.description:
Play any land from your hand, ensuring to play a basic Forest if you have one in hand.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Dryad Arbor token, untapping the basic Forest.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one additional time.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 3.

1284-2178-5136.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1284-2178-5136.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1684-2178-2292-4871.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1684-2178-2292-4871.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Rakka Mar and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Rakka Mar trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1283-2825-4036-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2825-4036-4222.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {3} and tapping it, casting a copy of Seething Song without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {5}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.

957-1309-4050-4935.manaNeeded: {8}{U} each odd-numbered turn, with {3}{U}{U} available each even-numbered turn
957-1309-4050-4935.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Conduit of Worlds by tapping it, causing you to pay {3}{U}{U} to cast Salvager of Secrets from your graveyard.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

145-2781-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
145-2781-4499.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Serra's Sanctum.
Repeat.

228-594-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
228-594-2034.description:
Activate Scuttletide by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Crab token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Crab, adding {C}{C}.
The Crab dies, triggering Skullclamp, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

690-4658-4961.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than an opponent's.
690-4658-4961.description:
Cast Inscription of Abundance by paying {1}{G}, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's power.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained this way.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1335-2757-4878.notablePrerequisites: Market Festival attached to a basic land.
1335-2757-4878.description:
Activate the enchanted land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Market Festival triggers, adding an additional {2}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature, untapping the enchanted land.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Repeat until Marath has no more +1/+1 counters.
Marath dies due to having 0 toughness and goes to the command zone.
Cast Marath by paying {R}{G}{W} plus commander tax.
Marath enters the battlefield with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to the amount of mana spent.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Marath any number of times, choosing any value for X.

352-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
352-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
